functional_selection: Unchanged primary gates; highest full-action fraction, then valid-structure fraction, then lowest step. Complete all declared candidates.
scope: Fresh official base, adapter and optimizer; no continuation from disposable probe. Four saved checkpoints must be evaluated in Colibri before acceptance.
learning_rate_reason: Bounded initial adaptation of the new base. This is an experimental rate, not a promised improvement or continuation of the prior tiny-rate 0.8B correction.
limitations: Backward propagation through all 32 layers is CPU expensive; longest-row time is not the average step time.
Initial and final 133-row teacher-forced validations are mandatory and are not accuracy measurements.
The run does not automatically export, evaluate, activate or train the next application.
